title: tarphochlamys affinis
intro: Tarphochlamys affinis, commonly known as the Himalayan snail vine, is a plant species belonging to the family Melastomataceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent.
